description: For every scoped formula \(\varphi\) in the equality-only or single-relation language, the numerical code used by effective quantifier elimination equals the general certified-proof formula code, with the same bound-slot indices.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.relational_syntax_code {o : Bool} {n : ℕ}
  (φ : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.Shared.Lang o).BoundedFormula Empty n) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EffectiveQuantifierElimination.syntaxCode φ =
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.formulaCode
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.relationalSignature o) Empty.elim φ
